svg.title: Light in a cavity of partially reflecting compartments, and the cavity's own mode
svg.desc: Two views of the same disc of circular compartments, whose walls each reflect part of the light and pass the rest. Left: a beam entering from the left splits at every wall; shading shows light per unit area, strongest near the entry. Right: the cavity's own mode, the pattern light settles into wherever it enters; shading shows each compartment's share of the light, which is largest in the centre compartment and falls off toward the rim.
svg.text: brightest in the centre, wherever light enters
Shading: light per unit area. Ray optics; each wall reflects 30% of the light head-on.
